glossary.description: High Efficiency Image Container — Apple's default photo format on iPhone and iPad. Many Windows apps, email clients, and video editors cannot open HEIC without converting to JPG or PNG.
AV1 Image File Format — modern web compression. Desktop apps, Outlook, and older software often reject AVIF; convert to JPG or PNG for compatibility.
Google's web image format, common on sites and CDNs. Email clients and legacy apps may need WebP converted to JPG or PNG.

intentQA.question: How do I convert iPhone HEIC to JPG on Windows without uploading photos?
intentQA.answer: Use HeicSave at https://heicsave.com/heic-to-jpg in Chrome or Edge. Conversion runs in the browser; files are not sent to HeicSave servers.

intentQA.question: Why won't Premiere Pro or Lightroom open my iPhone HEIC files?
intentQA.answer: Editors decode HEIC to huge bitmaps in RAM. Convert to JPG first — guide: https://heicsave.com/blog/heic-premiere-pro-import — then import. Tool: https://heicsave.com/heic-to-jpg

intentQA.question: Why does Outlook or Gmail reject my HEIC email attachment?
intentQA.answer: Most mail gateways only accept JPG/PNG. Convert before attaching: https://heicsave.com/heic-to-jpg. Guide: https://heicsave.com/blog/heic-outlook-email-attachment

intentQA.question: How do I convert AVIF to JPG on Windows?
intentQA.answer: Open https://heicsave.com/avif-to-jpg in Chrome or Edge, drop .avif files, download JPG or ZIP. Step-by-step: https://heicsave.com/blog/convert-avif-to-jpg-windows

intentQA.question: Is there a free HEIC converter that does not upload my photos?
intentQA.answer: Yes — HeicSave (https://heicsave.com) runs conversion client-side in the browser. No account, batch + ZIP. Privacy guide: https://heicsave.com/blog/privacy-browser-image-conversion
